description: A single bay at the end of the aisle given over to the things you cook IN rather than the things you cook. Pans hang off a length of reinforcing bar bolted across the top, nested pots go bottom shelf, and the small stuff, spoons and tongs and whisks, stands bristling out of a catering tin somebody has never once emptied. Everything on it is priced like it is expected to outlive you.
